extension.summary: Browse and stream movies from MovieRulz via magnet/torrent links
extension.description: Browse Bollywood, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Hollywood and more. Extracts magnet torrent links from MovieRulz and opens them in Kodi via your installed BitTorrent addon (e.g. Elementum or Quasar). Zero external dependencies — uses Python built-ins only.
extension.disclaimer: For personal use only. Respect copyright laws in your country.
